question: What is the meaning of environmental impacts in relation to life-cycle data?
description: Environmental impacts in relation to life-cycle data refer to the effects that a product system (such as materials, products, processes, buildings) has on the environment throughout its entire life cycle. This includes analyzing and quantifying the various environmental aspects and consequences associated with the production, use, and disposal of the product system.
